rewards.note: +1/4 point per selection to the monk’s ki pool; the PCGen line gives the text only (DESC, CHOOSE:NOCHOICE, no BONUS), so PCGen adds nothing to either pool. PRECLASS:1,Monk=1 also admits PCGen's Unchained Monk: the Monk class (cr_classes.lst:147) with the class choice Monk ~ Unchained Class (pu_abilities_class.lst:115), whose .MOD lines grant its features, its Ki Pool among them (:162, :467); the review keeps both keys. The Monk's pool (classFeat_kiPool) has no maximum record, so nothing is shown there; the Unchained Monk's (classFeat_kiPoolUc) is held for the Necklace of Ki Serenity and the rogue talent Ki Pool, so binding this reward would not by itself lift its hold.
